sin.name: suite-top-folder-file
sin.description: A class sits in a suite's or module's top folder outside its module and suite files, so the suite's parts are not where every suite keeps them.
sin.rule: A suite's or module's top folder holds only <suite>_module.py, <suite>_suite.py and __init__.py; every other class goes in its folder: models, commands, drivers, rules, guards, listeners, migrations or modules.
